beats.name: SHE WALKS INTO THE SHOP
cap: a famous American actress buys a travel
book from the man who owns the shop
beats.tag: MEET-CUTE — she comes to him, not the reverse

beats.name: THE SPILLED JUICE
cap: he spills orange juice on her in the street
and she changes clothes in his flat
beats.tag: CHEMISTRY — she kisses him at the door

beats.name: THE PRESS JUNKET
cap: taken for a reporter at her hotel,
he gets one free press conference
beats.tag: DOOR — the lie that will cost him

beats.name: HONEY'S BIRTHDAY
cap: he brings a film star to a family dinner
and she is the one who fits in
beats.tag: FRIENDS — the ordinary world she has never had

beats.name: THE WALLED GARDEN
cap: past a locked gate that is not his to open
they find a garden and kiss again
beats.tag: CHEMISTRY — the same beat, earned twice

beats.name: THE RESTAURANT
cap: at the next table men list the films she
made and the men she made them with
beats.tag: PRICE — the past she cannot outrun

beats.name: THE HOTEL ROOM
cap: he arrives at her door with a gift and
finds another man already in the room
beats.tag: SETBACK — she flies home in the morning

beats.name: SHE COMES BACK
cap: months later she is in London filming
and she calls him, and he comes
beats.tag: RESUME — the deal is made again

beats.name: THE STORY BREAKS
cap: the tabloids get the story and his quiet
street fills with photographers
beats.tag: BREAKUP — fame gets the last word

beats.name: JUST A GIRL
cap: standing in front of a boy, she asks to
be loved, and then she leaves
beats.tag: TURN — the speech he does not answer

beats.name: THE PRESS CONFERENCE
cap: his friends bundle him into the car and he
reaches the press conference in time
beats.tag: GESTURE — he says it in front of everyone

beats.name: THE CODA
cap: married, expecting a child, on a bench in
the park they used to walk through
beats.tag: CODA — the ordinary ending she chose
